name: grammar
description: Checks the English of each prompt you send to Claude Code and shows the fixes under it. Sends each prompt you type to Haiku (one small call per prompt) through your own Claude Code session

enabled.title: Check my prompts
enabled.description: Send each prompt you type to the model for an English check. /grammar on|off sets this too.

natural.title: Native-speaker line
natural.description: Also show how a native speaker would say a sentence when the phrasing is clearly off. /grammar natural on|off sets this too.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that checks each prompt. Sonnet catches more and costs more.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks about each prompt. Higher is slower and costs more.

dialect.title: Spelling
dialect.description: any accepts US and UK spelling alike; us or uk flags the other one's spellings.

min_words.title: Minimum words
min_words.description: Prompts with fewer words than this (ok, yes, continue) are not checked.

max_chars.title: Maximum characters
max_chars.description: How much of a long prompt is checked (and sent), cut at a word boundary.

icons.title: Nerd Font icons
icons.description: Off draws plain characters for terminals without a Nerd Font.

show_why.title: Show why
show_why.description: Show the short reason after each fix.
